verdicts.why: Wikipedia's episode 4 summary: the hordes kill Shang-Chi, Katy, Valkyrie, Rintrah, Parker and Lang in the battle defending the Infinity Hulk; Missing and 'fate unknown' are wrong.
Episode 4 summary lists Parker among those the hordes kill defending the Infinity Hulk, matching the settled zombie-world timeline; Deceased is right.
Episode 4 summary lists Lang among those the hordes kill defending the Infinity Hulk; Missing and 'fate unknown' are wrong.

MCU wiki (episode and Cull Obsidian pages): Nebula forces Cull Obsidian to ingest some Embers, foliage overtakes Knowhere, and the thieves leave carrying them; carried and used fits 'In use', not 'Secured'.

Wikipedia plot: Wade forces himself out of the Ice Box and later assaults the transfer convoy with X-Force, so he is not aboard; X-Men wiki: Black Tom is in a containment cell on the truck and Cable shoots him in it.

Wikipedia plot: after consulting Weasel, Wade decides to hunt Ajax and takes the name Deadpool from Weasel's dead pool; it is the recruiter who reveals Ajax's whereabouts, so Weasel does not help find him.
Wikipedia plot of Deadpool 2: Wade 'visits Blind Al, who unsuccessfully attempts to convince him to move on'; X-Men wiki says he breaks into her home, as he had been living with Vanessa.
Episode 1 summary: the X-Men save Roberto from the FoH; Marvel Database says they take him to the mansion that episode. Episode 3 (Goblin Queen) has no Roberto rescue.
Episode 16 summary: Danger bests the X-Men on Genosha until Xavier encourages Polaris to defeat her; Marvel Database lists her death in that episode (Season 2 6), so Missing is wrong.
Sources disagree: Wikipedia has two adamantium bullets to the head, the X-Men wiki has one in the back and then a shot to the head that causes the amnesia. The current record stands.
Wikipedia plot: Sabretooth ambushes Logan and Rogue, and Cyclops and Storm save them; Logan does not save Rogue from Sabretooth.

Episode 11 summary: Cyclops and Jean stay with Nathan and are captured by Apocalypse's followers, then rescued by the other X-Men; episode 12 ends with Nathan sending them back to the 1990s. The last event is in episode 12.
Same episode 11 and 12 summaries: Jean is captured with Nathan and rescued, not the one helping him escape, and Nathan sends the X-Men home in episode 12.
Wikipedia's episode list calls the group the Inner Circle Club, and Marvel Database notes the Hellfire Club was renamed Inner Circle Club for the show.

Wikipedia and Marvel Database: Magneto creates the blackout after Cooper frees him in episode 8, using the planet's magnetic field at the North Pole, and only then re-establishes Asteroid M, so the blackout does not come from Asteroid M.
Episode 5 summary: 'the Genoshan council asks Magneto to lead the country; he agrees on the condition that Rogue leads with him.'

Marvel Database's episode synopsis: Sabretooth burns the Inuit camp, ties the villagers to an ice bridge and falls into a chasm when Wolverine dodges him. The other X-Men are on Genosha and never meet him.

Wikipedia's episode list says the X-Men's rescue attempt is 'easily defeated by Gladiator' before the Phoenix steps in, which backs the current record. Marvel Database only mentions Gladiator beating Juggernaut, so at best the sources disagree and the current record stands.

Marvel Database and the Marvel Animated wiki: in Courage, Master Mold's head has Trask and Gyrich kidnapped to rebuild its body until Morph spikes its head. Trask's propane blast belongs to season 1's finale.
Episode 8 summary: 'Sousa apprehends Fennhoff while Carter defeats Underwood ... and convinces Stark not to drop the gas'; Fennhoff is then imprisoned with Zola.
Episode 40: Hydra captures Peterson; episode 41: Simmons and Ward save him from List's base, and List is not taken down (the intel goes to Hill for the Avengers).
MCU wiki plot of Progress: Simmons checks Elena's pulse while Fitz upgrades the watch, and Elena suggests they look for an apartment, which leaves Simmons intrigued.

MCU wiki cites Peterson in episodes 13, 16, 20, 21 and 22, none in 18. In episode 21 (Ragtag) Garrett rewards him with footage of his son held in a cell, which is the record's last event, after Garrett's episode 17 reveal.

Ward and May defeat the Paganists in episode 8 and S.H.I.E.L.D. takes the staff; the MCU wiki infoboxes for both Jakob Nystrom and Petra Larsen give their status as In Custody, and no source contradicts this.
Wikipedia's Past Life summary and the MCU wiki: Kasius forces only Tye to drink odium and sends him after the team, then drinks the rest himself, so 'fighters' is wrong.
